# Enerlyze

Enerlyze Private Limited is an energy intelligence company in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India. Enerlyzer is its household electricity analysis tool. This file is a navigation aid; the public pages are the source of truth.

- Company: https://www.enerlyze.in/about
- Enerlyzer product facts: https://www.enerlyze.in/enerlyzer
- Calculator: https://www.enerlyze.in/calculator
- Business energy analysis: https://www.enerlyze.in/business
- Calculation boundaries and sources: https://www.enerlyze.in/methodology
- Energy guides: https://www.enerlyze.in/guides
- Illustrative product previews: https://www.enerlyze.in/shop

Enerlyzer estimates electricity-related CO2 from bill and appliance inputs. It does not certify a whole-household or whole-organisation carbon footprint. Preview products are not currently purchasable. Continuous IoT monitoring is a future direction.
